The [[Imperial Dragon Spear]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
: [[Cold Dmg]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
: Damage +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]]) 
: Enchantments last 20% longer

==Replica==

*[[Imperial Spear]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
*[[Icy]] [[Spearhead]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Spear Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Guided by Fate]]" inscription
